heading: NOT (negative) nodes
text:
### NOT (negative) nodes [IRET.7.9]

A NOT node implements the `no Schema s` pattern. Its
semantics: a token passes through the NOT node only if
the join produces **zero** matches in the right memory.

idris.name: iret_7_9__blockers
idris.note: Each `no` pattern's blocker: given the bindings, does this live fact violate it.

idris.name: iret_7_9__is_blocked
idris.note: The same, against working memory.

idris.name: iret_7_9__is_blocked_with
idris.note: A token passes iff no `no` pattern has a matching fact: zero matches in the right memory, as the clause says.

idris.name: iret_7_9__neg_facts
idris.note: The live facts of each `no` kind -- the only part of working memory the blocking test reads.

idris.name: iret_7_9__neg_kinds
idris.note: The kinds of a rule's `no` patterns.

idris.name: iret_7_9__any_false
idris.note: No member satisfies the test, so none does.

idris.name: iret_7_9__blocked_cons
idris.note: Unblocked by the first and by the rest: unblocked by the list.

idris.name: iret_7_9__blocked_cons_inv
idris.note: Unblocked by a list of `no` patterns: unblocked by the first and by the rest.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__from_front_view
idris.note: EVERY TOKEN OF FIRELOOP'S RECOMPUTE from a front is a token of the network's: the guard's fact at each position is the join the node makes, and an unblocking `no` pattern is a NOT node with zero blockers.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__recompute_agrees
idris.note: THE TWO RECOMPUTES AGREE: the network's recompute of a chain over working memory is, as a set, FireLoop's match set of the rule the chain lowers to, less the matches a `no` pattern blocks.

idris.name: rlow_5_3__facts
idris.note: The live facts of each `no` pattern's kind, as Rete/FireLoop.idr reads them.

idris.name: rlow_5_3__tests
idris.note: The tests of a rule's `no` patterns; named so that no statement mentions a projection unapplied.

idris.name: iret_7_9__any_kind_sub
idris.note: A blocker satisfied by a fact of a memory is satisfied under any memory holding that fact.

idris.name: iret_7_9__blocked_negs_cons_inv_true
idris.note: Blocked with the first blocker unsatisfied: blocked by the rest.

idris.name: iret_7_9__blocked_negs_cons_rest
idris.note: Blocked by the rest is blocked.

idris.name: iret_7_9__blocked_negs_cons_true
idris.note: A satisfied first blocker blocks.

idris.name: iret_7_9__blocked_negs_sub
idris.note: Blocked, blocker by blocker, under a memory: blocked under any larger one.

idris.name: iret_7_9__is_blocked_sub
idris.note: A `no` pattern blocked under a memory is blocked under any larger one: a retraction only ever releases.

idris.name: iret_7_9__any_ext
idris.note: Two tests that agree on every member are found alike by `any`.

idris.name: iret_7_9__blocked_negs
idris.note: Blocking, blocker by blocker: any blocker with a live fact of its kind joining the tuple.

idris.name: iret_7_9__blocked_negs_cons
idris.note: Unblocked by the first and by the rest: unblocked by the list.

idris.name: iret_7_9__blocked_negs_cons_inv
idris.note: Unblocked by a list of blockers: unblocked by the first and by the rest.

idris.name: iret_7_9__blocked_negs_same
idris.note: Blockers that are one block alike.

idris.name: iret_7_9__bool_of_false
idris.note: Two Booleans false together are equal.

idris.name: iret_7_9__is_blocked_negs
idris.note: FireLoop's blocking over the zipped blockers is blocking blocker by blocker.

idris.name: iret_7_9__is_blocked_same
idris.note: Rules that are one block the same tuples.

idris.name: Iret_7_9__positive
idris.note: A positive program: no rule has a `no` pattern. The bridge's scope, since an absence antecedent is not a justification Refcount carries.

idris.name: iret_7_9__unblocked
idris.note: A rule without `no` patterns blocks nothing.
